messages:
Sasha (People Ops): quick one - Marta had an ER visit while on a company trip and submitted an expense. Insurer covered part; she needs the remainder paid off-cycle if possible. what docs do we need to finalize?

Marta (Product): hi - yes. clinic bill was 950 (local currency), insurer paid 500. i uploaded the itemized bill + insurer EOB to Expensify. manager approved in workflow. do i need anything else?

Liam (Finance): we can reimburse uncovered emergency medical costs for approved business travel. required: itemized clinic receipt, insurer EOB showing payments, brief incident summary (date/clinic/treatment), and manager approval. confirm trip was company-approved.

Priya (Legal): add legal note: ensure EOB shows line-by-line so we avoid double-pay. if insurer retained subrogation rights or already paid the specific charge, we can't reimburse that same line. if employee signed paperwork waiving insurer reimbursement, that must be documented.

Ravi (Manager): confirmed this was approved travel and I signed off on the expense.

Sasha (People Ops): policy reminder: emergency medical expenses while traveling on company business are reimbursable after personal insurance; receipts & EOB required within 60 days. we can approve off-cycle for urgent personal-card hits.

Marta (Product): thanks — added an incident note to the expense: "2026-05-12, acute gastroenteritis, Emergency Care Center Madrid. Total paid: 950; insurer paid: 500 on 2026-05-15. Requesting 450." attachments: itemized bill, EOB, manager approval screenshot.

Liam (Finance): i'll review the EOB for overlapping line items. if clean, i'll push an off-cycle payment. if insurer later reimburses for the same outstanding amount, we'll reconcile and may recover it.

expense-bot: :white_check_mark: Expense EXP-5033 submitted and flagged for off-cycle review.

Marta (Product): off-cycle please — personal card charged. really appreciate the quick turnaround! :pray:
note: off-cycle med expense reimbursement for overseas ER; includes docs checklist and policy reminder
